answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital commitment, preventing a lone actor from spawning a thread of malicious nodes. The network maintains its pulse through economic finality, ensuring that any attempt to dilute consensus necessitates the acquisition of majority assets. Like shifting grains in a dune, the cost to an attacker is not merely technical but requires prohibitive financial expenditure to overwhelm the distributed ledger.
